contributions.observed_outcome: Panoptes executes Qworld's complete 17-stage Recursive Expansion Tree as a durable typed run: scenario grounding plus 3 expansion rounds, perspective generation plus 4 expansion rounds and review, criteria generation plus 3 expansion rounds and review, polarity checking, and score calibration. Every successor prompt contains validated prerequisite artifacts and a monotonic revision. Tests reach pending_review and prove that generic or stale receipts, schema and lineage loss, inconsistent state, destructive calibration, polarity reversal, and unsupported score balance fail closed.
